initialization: Same original task-trained OneRef checkpoint for both arms; continued training, not pretrained-from-scratch reproduction
repeat_policy: Repeat after first paired long run has clear positive development evidence
freeze: Backbone frozen, original grounding heads trained
finetune: All encoder blocks and grounding heads trained
teacher: Fixed teacher_train18 original and verified predictions, no test data
teacher_quality: Training GT relativeIoU>0.01 and teacherIoU>=0.5; otherwise original anchor
clear_gain: Provisional >=0.5pp over original plus matched baseline, consistent seeds and paired95%CI excluding0
test_policy: testA/B not used for repeated tuning
checkpoint: Atomic epoch-boundary optimizer/model/RNG recovery; development-best and final separate
storage: Completed optimizer resume and temporary archive pruned only after OSS success200; best/final weights retained
